title: UR wrist test rig
subtitle: CAN 14 / 15 / 16 on the One Dof Test Rack, lying on its side
summary: Three SteadyWin GIM4305-10 (10:1, encoder on the rotor) on moteus C1. The model is the cad2robot bundle the coverage lane loads (3f7ef84); the nominal values are the 2026-11-10 twin of record's (bam_ur_wrist.plant.PlantTruth defaults, the bundle's placeholders) and the 583ee39 mass prior. The calibration sequence is sysid/examples/ur_wrist_test_rig/rig.py (the one-click seam).

known.note: configuration the description states and no routine touches
known.board_gains: bam_ur_wrist_coverage.rig.RAM_GAINS: kp 75 N.m/rev, kd 2.4 / 1 / 1 N.m/(rev/s), ki 0 (the gains every real motion ran at)
known.board: moteus C1, 2 A x Kt 0.5087 = 1.017 N.m cap, 200 Hz current loop (bam_ur_wrist.actuator.GIM4305)
known.stops: the physical stops at +-0.4583 rev (165 deg): Zach's tview constant for the fatter hard stop (bam_ur_wrist.plant.PlantTruth.stop_rad)
known.gear_stiffness_source: estimate: a 43 mm gimbal actuator's 10:1 planetary (none published); the backlash and homing routines' give correction uses it
known.encoder: the rotor encoder through 10:1; the board reports the output position in steps of 2 pi / 65536 rad
known.gravity: |g| 9.81 m/s^2; its direction is a parameter (wrist.gravity_polar_rad / azimuth_rad: real up in the twin's base frame)

real_floors_deg.source: the real lane's repeat floors, 5 same-input repeats, driven (bam_ws claude/ur-wrist-real @ 6e26aa27a)

sensors.measures: the motor-side angle and speed at the output (the board's report)

schedule.use: train: gravity, staircase, dither, plateaus, chirp, jog, sweep per board; held out: jog_heldout, sweep_heldout; CAN 14's plans built by the same builder (bam_ur_wrist_coverage.plans) with CAN 14 let move
